Read `AGENTS.md` before making changes and follow its rules.

Work only inside `frontend/`. Keep the app as a single-page app with shared CSS and JavaScript loaded once. Views belong in `frontend/views/`. Use HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap 5 as covered in the course materials. Do not connect the frontend to the backend before the milestone that requires it. Do not add comments or AI references to source code. Do not add libraries without asking me first.

Make small changes, then list changed files and how they were checked outside the source files.
